name: Kisaragi Yuito
source:
Whenever the Twin Angels are in trouble, the phantom thief Misty Knight appears. His true identity is Yuito Kisaragi, the student council president of St. Cherine School and Haruka's senior. His special attack 'Rose Needle' is powerful enough to pierce even metal.

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character6.html]official site[/url]]
